checks.name: Actual WordPress core and database are loaded
Plugin activation survives a fresh PHP bootstrap
Shortcode registers on the init lifecycle
Stylesheet is enqueued through the frontend lifecycle
Default count returns three latest published posts
Bounded count input 1 renders 1 cards
Bounded count input 2 renders 2 cards
Bounded count input 0 renders 1 cards
Bounded count input -99 renders 1 cards
Bounded count input 999999 renders 12 cards
Bounded count input abc renders 3 cards
Bounded count input 2.5 renders 3 cards
Unknown attributes do not alter the selection
Category slug selects the expected real database rows
A second category excludes the first category
Missing category has a readable empty state
An invalid nonempty category fails closed
Draft, private, protected, scheduled and page content are excluded
Public selection remains public for a logged-in administrator
Query has a hard limit and skips pagination totals
Sticky posts do not override newest-first order
Shortcode returns its markup without echoing
The surrounding main Loop is preserved
A nested Loop is preserved and WordPress can reset to the main Loop
Query exceptions render a safe error state and preserve the Loop
Untrusted title and excerpt output cannot introduce active HTML
Filtered javascript URLs are rejected by WordPress URL escaping
Empty titles receive a descriptive accessible link label
Cards use named links and machine-readable dates
